pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are based on Gayle Laakmann McDowell's Cracking the Coding Interview (CTCI) book. This is for students who are already familiar with topics from CTCI in their native language but who are looking to get stronger discussing Stack/Queues/Strings/Tree/Graphs/System Design/etc in English.

Please just do a single class to start. The first class addresses _how_ to answer a question AKA the Problem Solving flowchart. (listen, example, brute force, optimize using BUD, walk through, implement, test)

Lesson Schedule:

0: The Problem-Solving Flowchart
1. Arrays and Strings
2. Linked Lists
3. Stacks and Queues
4. Trees and Graphs
5. Bit Manipulation
6. Math and Logic Puzzles
7. Object-Oriented Design
8. Recursion and DP
9. System Design and Scalability
10. Sorting and Search

Typical Class:
- Before the class: you read the next chapter
- In class, I give you an _easy_ question from the lesson
- You answer (following the flow chart) using pseudocode
- I give you hints and English tips as we go
- After class, you read and prepare the next lesson

Important!!! If you're looking to do this class but the price is too high, message me. I'm also looking for students to do it for my YT channel. For those students, the price is lower. Message me if this interests you.

pro_course_detail.title: Italian language course. From A1 Elementary to C2 Advanced.
pro_course_detail.description:
Please specify your level when booking your first class so that I can better prepare for the lesson :D

Absolute beginners and beginners: In this course, we typically start with phonetics to familiarize you with the main sounds of the Italian language. After a few lessons, you'll be able to greet people, introduce yourself and others, order food, book a room, and engage in small talk. For this type of course, I usually follow the syllabus of some language books for foreigners to ensure a precise structure and cover all aspects.

Intermediate: In this course, you will enhance your pronunciation, expand your vocabulary, and deepen your knowledge of grammar. You'll learn to discuss specific topics such as daily activities, hobbies, family, dining in restaurants, shopping, sports, travel, and more. At this stage, our goal is to encourage you to speak and interact as much as possible. While there are planned reinforcement exercises for home practice, they are not compulsory and are at your discretion. The exercises encompass listening, written production, and grammar.

Advanced: In this course, you will learn to express yourself in more complex situations at an advanced level. We will engage in real conversations and delve into specific topics such as culture, sports, education, Italian food, and habits, among others. Each lesson will not only focus on vocabulary and grammar (when necessary) but also on enhancing speaking and interaction as much as possible. Home exercises, audio tracks, and/or reading newspaper articles may complement the course.

pro_course_detail.title: INGLESE PER ITALIANI - English lessons for Italian speakers only
pro_course_detail.description: Questo corso è principalmente destinato agli adulti di lingua italiana che desiderano imparare l'inglese da zero o migliorare un livello di base. Il corso comprende lo studio dell'inglese, con particolare attenzione al vocabolario, alla grammatica (appresa soprattutto in modo passivo, secondo il metodo naturale comunicativo) e alla pronuncia. Le lezioni possono essere personalizzate in base alle tue esigenze e preferenze individuali. Se parti da zero, in poche lezioni sarai in grado di presentarti, parlare della tua famiglia, descrivere persone/situazioni e condizioni psicofisiche (stati d'animo, malesseri...) e discutere di studio e lavoro. Se parti da un livello di base, possiamo concentrarci sull'arricchimento del vocabolario, sulla conversazione e sull'acquisizione di una pronuncia corretta. In ogni caso, stabiliremo insieme il programma da seguire durante la nostra lezione di prova.

You may have asked yourself whether there is some effective method that can make you speak English fluently, efficiently, and with confidence.
Well, there is such a method!
With my English Conversation Dialogues, you can immerse yourself in real English conversations that tell an authentic story through a variety of dialogues. Each dialogue has been written and edited by native English speakers, so you can be sure that you are getting the most natural English grammar, vocabulary, and phrases.
Each lesson also comes with comprehension questions to test your understanding of the story and the English used. No drills or grammatical exercises are necessary to learn English!

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson type is for those wishing to improve their ability to naturally speak the English language. This can also include improving your ability to read in English, as well. Conversations will ultimately be based around the goals of the student - there is no single defined structure for every lesson because every student is different. Some students want to have a purely random conversation where the topic can potentially change over time. Other students prefer to focus on a specific topic or have a specific goal in mind (a future interview, job presentation, meeting, etc.). I consider myself to be rather flexible in what I do on iTalki. 

During the lesson, I will be constantly listening to your English and offering corrections, suggestions, or new words and expressions. Many of these will also be typed out. If I notice consistent mistakes or major grammatical errors, additional focus can be placed on correcting those mistakes. I am also open to any questions you may have regarding English (grammar questions, questions about something your read or watched, questions about slang, etc.). 

Ultimately, the goal of these lessons is to improve a student's confidence and comfortability in speaking with a native speaker. Speaking with anyone in a foreign language can be very intimidating at first, but it is my hope that you will feel comfortable and able to speak freely without fear. This is not a judgement zone. 

** PLEASE NOTE that I do NOT teach children. I believe that teaching children requires particular experience. I recommend that you look for one of the many great professional teachers or community tutors on iTalki who have experience teaching children and especially beginners. 

If you are interested in purchasing a package of lessons but have not yet spoken to me, please contact me beforehand so we can discuss your goals and desires for the lesson.

In our trial class I want to get to know you, I want to know why you are improving your English, what your goals are, and where you think the biggest challenges are when communicating in English.

pro_course_detail.title: CONVERSATION and CONFIDENCE building - Improve vocabulary, fluency, and grammar
pro_course_detail.description:
Conversation classes are a really natural and easy way to improve your confidence, fluency, grammar, and vocabulary. We do all of this in context, focussing on the grammar mistakes that you make most often and looking at new vocabulary that you will actually use! Conversation based calls/classes are great if :

👉  You want to improve your English conversation skills, for work or anything else.
👉  Your English is at a high level but you still want to improve.
👉  You're getting ready to work or live in an English speaking place.
👉  You used to speak a lot of English and now you just want to maintain your English level.
👉  You've been studying English for a while but you're not sure how to improve or what you should study next!

📌 These classes work best when we agree a topic or subject before class that you would like to discuss. This way I can bring materials and resources to class that can help you get the most out of our time. If you don't have anything in particular that you would like to discuss then I am happy to suggest a topic for us. 

Materials can include almost anything! However, I most often use:

📎 Videos (I keep a list of YouTube channels with great videos to build classes around).

📎 Articles (Articles from anywhere are great, and I keep a list of great article websites to get use started).

📎 My own conversation class documents, (I'll introduce you to all of the materials I've created during our first call).

📝 At the end of our call I will always send you the notes that I have made, including any corrections, recommendations, and new vocabulary. 📝

If you have any questions, feel free to send me a message!

pro_course_detail.title: BUSINESS ENGLISH - Improve the way you communicate at work
pro_course_detail.description:
In these classes we work on your ability to communicate in English at work. I always build classes around your needs and goals. If there is something in specific that you need help with please let me know. In the past I've helped people with:

📌  Preparation for presentations.
📌  Getting ready for job interviews.
📌  Role playing meetings
📌  Editing letters, slide decks, emails, etc.
📌  CV / Resume editing

pro_course_detail.title: JOB INTERVIEW preparation - Learn the theory and skills to get the job
pro_course_detail.description:
I really enjoy job interviews. In the past I've interviewed people for jobs on HIGH PERFORMING, business-to-business, sales teams. Now I want to pass on the knowledge I have of how interviewers think and the best way to communicate your skills in a job interview.

Here are some of the things we'll do on these calls:

📌  We'll ROLE PLAY the most common job interview questions and analyse your answers. We'll consider both your English grammar, vocabulary, and the way you answered the question.

📌 We'll not only think about what the best answers are, but why those answers work. You will understand the theory behind giving great job interview answers.

📌 We'll think about questions that you found difficult in job interviews in the past and common job interview questions in your industry. Then we'll apply advanced job interview techniques and theory to make sure you're giving the best answers.

📌 We'll build a high quality library of useful stories from your experience that you can use to answer any job interview question.

📌 We'll think about the 2 MOST COMMON follow up questions to make sure that you're ready for any thing your interview brings.

📌 We'll talk about what to say when you don't know what to say. How to build longer, high quality answers, and what your interviewer REALLY wants to hear.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS test preparation - Need a 6.5? Aiming higher? Let's do this!
pro_course_detail.description:
Preparing for the IELTS test can be a really big challenge, but working with an experienced, professional English tutor can make it a lot easier!

Here are some of the ways I can help you:

📌 I can help you find the mistakes you make most often and explain how to correct them in a relaxed and helpful way that helps you to learn. At the end of each class you will leave with all of the notes I've made for you including corrections, examples, suggestions, and new resources.

📌 We will work with actual questions from IELTS tests from our first class so that you have experience with real test materials.

📌  I can help you with the speaking, writing, reading, and listening parts of the test. If you know where you need the most help and which parts of the test you are most worried about then those are the parts that we'll focus on.

If you have any questions about how we can work together then please send me a message. I'm excited to help you on your IELTS journey!
